Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery, which can freeze widgets. If that happens, let OpenGIFWidget run without restrictions:

• Samsung: App info › Battery › Unrestricted
• Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO: App info › Autostart on, and Battery saver › No restrictions
• OnePlus, OPPO, realme: App info › Battery usage › Allow background activity
• Huawei, Honor: Battery › App launch › OpenGIFWidget › Manage manually

Restarting your device also redraws every widget.
